MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The prototype PCB boards fit my breadboards, components, and relay projects because they offer a practical way to turn an experimental circuit into a soldered assembly.",
    "The banana test leads fit my interest in building and testing small circuits, provided their connectors work with my equipment."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another caster set does not meet a current need because I already bought heavy-duty casters; similarity to that purchase does not mean I need a replacement.",
    "The large step drill, adhesives, magnets, and wood screws need specific projects to be useful to me, and I do not currently have those tasks.",
    "The 3D printer requires a larger commitment than my small electronics projects justify, while the rotary changeover switch does not fit the kind of circuits I have been building."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hands-on projects seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop or craft supply.",
    "My recent caster purchase seems to have been treated as a reason to buy more casters, even though it already addressed that need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of breadboards, circuit boards, connectors, and a small relay point toward supplies that support small circuit assembly and testing.",
    "I choose items when they serve a concrete next step, with the right connectors, dimensions, and electrical requirements; broad DIY usefulness is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my small electronics interests but extended them too broadly into general DIY supplies and repeat purchases."
}
